environment.description: Same Celery worker code deployed in a Kubernetes 1.28 cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at the namespace level via label-based admission (pod-security.kubernetes.io/enforce: restricted). The 'analytics-prod' namespace has the restricted profile which rejects pods with: privileged=true, hostPath volumes, runAsNonRoot violations, and capabilities beyond NET_BIND_SERVICE. Additionally, the cluster runs a Kyverno ClusterPolicy 'disallow-host-path-write' that independently validates no hostPath or emptyDir volumes with medium='' are writable. Workers use an emptyDir with medium=Memory (tmpfs) for ephemeral scratch but the import_external_cache task's path argument is validated against a ConfigMap-defined allowlist of paths under /tmp/analytics-scratch only. The Redis instance requires mTLS with client certificates rotated via cert-manager, and NetworkPolicy restricts ingress to the Redis pod to only pods with label app=celery-worker in the same namespace.
